text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Morniiing~! Hey, hey, did you get to relax 
on your days off~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"As for me, I played a whole bunch with 
Sei-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Playin' with kitties in the park~, takin' 
a nap~, skippin' stones in the pond~, 
takin' another nap~...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I stretched out a whole bunch! So I'm 
totally full of energy~! U~ra-ra~♪

Perhaps influenced by Seiun Sky, Haru 
Urara was somehow acting rather laid-back.
